# Graphics

10 tools. Back to the [index](README.md).

## `get_decal_info`

Read the full UDecalComponent state (size, sort order, fade screen size, fade-out/in timing, color, material) of a named DecalActor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, actor_name: string, decal_size_x: float, decal_size_y: float, decal_size_z: float, sort_order: int, fade_screen_size: float, fade_start_delay: float, fade_duration: float, fade_in_start_delay: float, fade_in_duration: float, destroy_owner_after_fade: bool, r: float, g: float, b: float, a: float, decal_material: string }`

## `set_decal_color`

Set DecalColor on an editor-world ADecalActor found by label; it only shows if the decal material uses a Decal Color node. A color that is not a 4-number array is ignored (current color kept). No undo, dirty flag or save; returns the resulting r, g, b, a.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |
| `color` | array | no | Array of exactly 4 numbers [r, g, b, a], a linear color such as [1, 0.5, 0, 1]; missing or another length keeps the current DecalColor. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, r: float, g: float, b: float, a: float }`

## `set_decal_destroy_owner_after_fade`

Toggle the bDestroyOwnerAfterFade bit on a UDecalComponent. The existing set_decal_fade cmd always passes DestroyOwnerAfterFade=true to SetFadeOut; this cmd lets callers flip it independently and read it back. Implementation: writes the FadeOut triad through SetFadeOut(start, duration, destroy) using the current FadeStartDelay/FadeDuration so the other two fields are preserved.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |
| `destroy_owner_after_fade` | boolean | no | New value for the bDestroyOwnerAfterFade bit (true = auto-destroy the actor once fully faded). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, destroy_owner_after_fade: bool, fade_start_delay: float, fade_duration: float }`

## `set_decal_fade`

Set a UDecalComponent's fade-out/fade-in timing fields on a named DecalActor.  Writes the EditAnywhere fields directly (mirrors the details panel) so values round-trip exactly, avoiding SetFadeOut's global fade-scale CVar and SetLifeSpan side effect.  Only provided fields change (partial, idempotent).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |
| `fade_start_delay` | number | no | Optional seconds before fade-out begins (FadeStartDelay; 0 + fade_duration 0 = persistent). |
| `fade_duration` | number | no | Optional fade-out duration in seconds (FadeDuration). |
| `fade_in_start_delay` | number | no | Optional seconds before fade-in begins (FadeInStartDelay). |
| `fade_in_duration` | number | no | Optional fade-in duration in seconds (FadeInDuration). |
| `destroy_owner_after_fade` | boolean | no | Optional: destroy the owning actor after fully fading out (bDestroyOwnerAfterFade). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, fade_start_delay: float, fade_duration: float, fade_in_start_delay: float, fade_in_duration: float, destroy_owner_after_fade: bool, applied_count: int }`

## `set_decal_fade_in`

Set the FadeInStartDelay and FadeInDuration on a UDecalComponent via UDecalComponent::SetFadeIn (the existing SetFadeOut cmd only sets the *out* fields; this cmd sets the *in* pair).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |
| `start_delay` | number | no | Time in seconds before the decal begins fading in (default 0). |
| `duration` | number | no | Time in seconds for the fade-in to complete (default 0 = no fade-in). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, fade_in_start_delay: float, fade_in_duration: float }`

## `set_decal_fade_screen_size`

Set the FadeScreenSize on a UDecalComponent (the screen-size fraction below which the decal fades out).  The writer for the value get_decal_info already reads.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |
| `fade_screen_size` | number | yes | New FadeScreenSize (0..1; smaller fades the decal only when it gets very small on screen). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, fade_screen_size: float }`

## `set_decal_size`

Set the DecalSize half-extent on a UDecalComponent parented under a DecalActor.

|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |
| `decal_size` | string | no | Optional [x, y, z] half-extent (overrides size_x/size_y/size_z). |
| `size_x` | number | no | Optional X half-extent. |
| `size_y` | number | no | Optional Y half-extent. |
| `size_z` | number | no | Optional Z half-extent. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, size_x: float, size_y: float, size_z: float }`

## `set_decal_sort_order`

Set the SortOrder int on a UDecalComponent (lower draws first within the same decal bucket).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the ADecalActor in the editor world. |
| `sort_order` | number | no | New sort order value. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, sort_order: int }`

## `spawn_decal_actor`

Spawns a DecalActor into the editor world.  If material_path loads as a UMaterialInterface it is assigned to the UDecalComponent (SetDecalMaterial). Size may be a uniform number or an [x, y, z] half-extent applied to DecalSize (read back).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label for the spawned (or re-used) ADecalActor. |
| `location` | string | no | Optional [x, y, z] world location (default 0,0,0). |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] world rotation. |
| `decal_size` | string | no | Optional [x, y, z] half-extent for DecalSize (default 128,256,256). |
| `material_path` | string | no | Optional content path of a UMaterialInterface to assign to the decal. |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, actor_name: string, reused: bool, decal_size_x: float, decal_size_y: float, decal_size_z: float, decal_material: string }`
